title: 第7章 耐心

content_zh:
昆汀这个黑人拔出了腰间的那把刀，这把刀的形状有些怪异，和一般的精工细作的军用刀具相比显得粗鄙而简陋。
昆汀像是在自言自语地道，“这把刀跟了我很久。它不是什么好刀，只是用来收割香蕉的。但是这把刀却无数次把我从死亡的边缘拉了回来。我在大屠杀中活了下来，所以靠的除了这把刀，就是忍耐和警觉。”
那个之前高喊着不想干了的年轻人，看着这个阴郁得如同石头一样的黑人，已经有些脸色不好地后退。他似乎有些后悔刚才的冲动了，但是现在说什么都没用了。
昆汀把那把刀插在雪地上，而就在同时，他的拳头已经砸在了那个年轻人的脸上。年轻人被打得一仰头的工夫，昆汀陡然抬起膝盖狠狠撞在他的腹部。
那个年轻人哼都没有哼一声地倒下来了，他脸上的血溅在雪地上，触目惊心。
昆汀一脚将他的头踩进了雪地里，喝道，“你知不知道，一个真正的图西族猎手为了一只猎物，要付出多少代价？我曾经光着脚追逐一头羚羊，在非洲的烈日之下连续四五个小时不停地奔跑。等我用长矛刺穿那头羚羊的躯体时，它甚至已经站着不动了，因为它已经精疲力竭。”
那个被踩在雪地里的人努力挣扎着想要抬起头，但是却被死死地踩在雪地上。
这些佣兵们学员个个都惊惶了起来，林锐更是起身喝道，“够了，你这样会杀了他的！”他的一把握住了昆汀的手腕。
昆汀看了他一眼，甩开他的手，冷冷地道，“羚羊跑得很快，至少比人要快多了，但是你知道我为什么能够追上它？足迹，气息，它啃食过的草，都是让它被我追到的原因。你以为我让你们趴在雪地里只是为了好玩么？我是在教你们，如何隐藏自己。学会警觉，学会忍耐，只有这样才能生存。战场规则很简单，在战场上的人只有两种选择，要么猎杀，要么被猎杀。”
昆汀抬起了自己的脚，转过身看了林锐一眼，对他道，“你，扶着他继续回到雪地里趴着。你们两个人的训练时间各加一倍。对于他，必须训练耐性。而对于你，需要磨掉你身上的血性。冒失和冲动，每天有很多菜鸟军人都是死于这两个毛病。”
“那，我们是不是可以走了？”秦奋有些试探着道。
“不可以。因为这个人是你们的队友。而在队友遇到危险的时候，却只有他一个人站出来。”昆汀冷酷地一笑道，“这说明你们所有人都缺乏团队意识，所以都得留下。训练时间同样延长。”
当这次训练结束的时候，林锐的双腿甚至已经被冻得失去了知觉，完全是强撑着走回了训练基地内部。他感觉自己迈动的两条腿几乎已经不是自己的了。他身边的其他人也没有比他好到哪里去，在这冰天雪地里趴在雪中，各个都冻得脸色发青。
“你们所有人，全部去唐那里，接受检查。我可不想有人为此缺席下次的训练。”昆汀看了这些人一眼，冷冷地道。
唐坤给他们检查了一遍，确定他们没事，才让这些佣兵学员各自回去。
这时，赵建飞走了进来，看着昆汀笑了笑，“今天第一天，你对他们的感觉如何？”
“一群垃圾而已。”昆汀冷冷地道。
“也不完全是。”唐坤缓缓地道，“他们都接受过基本的军事训练，具备一定的素质，新人能有这样也算不错了。”
“不过，那个中国小子有点意思。今天居然差点出手反抗我。”昆汀吸了一口烟缓缓地道。
赵建飞耸耸肩道，“他们都是中国小子，你知道这批学员都是从中国来的。你说的是哪个，嗯，是林锐？”

“抱歉，我还不很清楚他们的名字，不过应该就是那个。”昆汀看了他一眼道，“据说他一来就打败了白熊？”
“算是吧，不过你并不是第一个看好他的人。”赵建飞缓缓地道，“他是银狼亲自招收的。”
唐坤微微一怔，“米歇尔？”
“嗯。你知道的，能被他看上眼的，绝对不会太差。行了，都休息吧，明天还得接着折腾这帮初哥。”赵建飞一笑转身走了出去。在外面的走廊上，他经过林锐的身边时，顺势拍了一下林锐的肩膀淡淡地道，“小子，过来一下，我有话跟你说。”

content_en:
Quentin, a black man, pulled out the knife from his waist. The shape of the knife was a bit weird, and it looked crude and crude compared with the ordinary finely crafted military knives.
Quentin seemed to be talking to himself, "This knife has been with me for a long time. It is not a good knife, it is just used to harvest bananas. But this knife has pulled me back from the edge of death countless times. I survived the massacre, so besides this knife, I rely on patience and vigilance."
The young man who had shouted that he didn't want to do it anymore looked at this black man who was as gloomy as a stone and backed away with a bad expression. He seemed to regret his earlier impulse, but it was useless to say anything now.
Quentin stuck the knife in the snow, and at the same time, his fist smashed into the young man's face. When the young man raised his head after being beaten, Quentin suddenly raised his knee and hit him hard in the abdomen.
The young man fell down without a groan, and the blood on his face splashed on the snow, which was shocking.
Quentin stamped his head into the snow and shouted, "Do you know how much a real Tutsi hunter has to pay for a prey? I once chased an antelope with bare feet and ran non-stop for four or five hours under the hot African sun. When I pierced the body of the antelope with a spear, it had even stood still because it was exhausted."
The man who was trampled on the snow struggled to raise his head, but was trampled firmly on the snow.
All the mercenary students were frightened, and Lin Rui stood up and shouted, "That's enough, you'll kill him if you do this!" He grabbed Quentin's wrist.
Quentin glanced at him, shook off his hand, and said coldly, "Antelope runs very fast, at least much faster than people, but do you know why I can catch up with it? The footprints, breath, and the grass it has gnawed are all the reasons why it was caught by me. Do you think I let me catch it? Are you lying in the snow just for fun? I am teaching you how to hide yourself. Only in this way can you survive. The rules of the battlefield are simple. People on the battlefield have only two choices, either hunt or be hunted. "
Quentin raised his feet, turned around, glanced at Lin Rui, and said to him, "You, support him and continue to lie down in the snow. The training time for both of you will be doubled. For him, you must train patience. For you, you need to wear off the bloodiness in you. Many rookie soldiers die from these two problems every day due to recklessness and impulsiveness."
"Then, can we leave?" Qin Fen asked tentatively.
"No. Because this person is your teammate. And when his teammates are in danger, he is the only one who stands up." Quentin smiled coldly, "This shows that all of you lack team awareness, so you all have to stay. The training time is also extended."
When the training ended, Lin Rui's legs were so cold that he lost consciousness, and he walked back to the training base with complete force. He felt that the legs he was moving were almost no longer his. The other people around him were no better than him. They were lying in the snow in the ice and snow, and their faces were blue with cold.
"All of you, go to Tang's place and get checked. I don't want anyone to miss the next training because of this." Quentin glanced at these people and said coldly.
Tang Kun checked them and made sure they were fine before letting the mercenary students go back individually.
At this time, Zhao Jianfei came in, looked at Quentin and smiled, "On the first day today, how do you feel about them?"
"It's just a bunch of trash." Quentin said coldly.
"Not entirely." Tang Kun said slowly, "They have all received basic military training and have certain qualities. Can newcomers have such skills?"This is not bad. "
“But that Chinese guy is a bit interesting. Today he almost resisted me. "Quentin took a puff of cigarette and said slowly.
Zhao Jianfei shrugged and said, "They are all Chinese boys, you know these students are all from China. Which one are you talking about, um, Lin Rui? "
“Sorry, I don’t know their names quite yet, but that’s probably the one. Quentin glanced at him and said, "It is said that he defeated the white bear as soon as he came?" "
"That's right, but you are not the first person to be optimistic about him. "Zhao Jianfei said slowly, "He was recruited by Yin Lang himself. "
Tang Kun was slightly startled, "Michelle? "
"Um. You know, someone who catches his eye is definitely not too bad. Okay, let's all rest. We have to continue tormenting these junior brothers tomorrow. "Zhao Jianfei smiled and turned around and walked out. When he passed Lin Rui in the corridor outside, he patted Lin Rui's shoulder and said lightly, "Boy, come here, I have something to tell you. "
